1: // Manifest basenames yul knows how to check, mirroring pkg/*'s Filename()
2: // values (githubactions workflows use MatchesPath instead of a fixed name,
3: // so they're matched separately below).
4: const MANIFEST_RE = /(^|[/\\ '"=])(pom\.xml|requirements\.txt|pyproject\.toml|package\.json|go\.mod|Cargo\.toml|\.github\/workflows\/[^\s'"]+\.ya?ml)(?=[/\\ '"]|$)/
5: // Shell constructs that mutate a file's *content* on disk - not an
6: // exhaustive parse of bash, just enough to catch the bypass a live model
7: // actually used (`printf ... > requirements.txt`) plus its common cousins.
8: const WRITE_RE = />>?(?!&)|\btee\b|\bsed\s+-i|\bperl\s+-i|\bdd\s+of=|\bcp\s|\bmv\s/
9: 
10: export const YulPlugin = async () => {
11:   const YUL_BIN = process.env.YUL_BIN || "yul"
12:   return {
13:     "tool.execute.before": async (input, output) => {
14:       if (input.tool === "bash") {
15:         const cmd = output.args.command || ""
16:         if (MANIFEST_RE.test(cmd) && WRITE_RE.test(cmd)) {
17:           throw new Error(
18:             "yul: use the write or edit tool to modify dependency manifests, not bash " +
19:             "(bash writes bypass the outdated-dependency check)"
20:           )
21:         }
22:         return
23:       }
24:       if (input.tool !== "write" && input.tool !== "edit") return
25:       const a = output.args
26:       const payload = input.tool === "write"
27:         ? { tool_name: "Write", tool_input: { file_path: a.filePath, content: a.content } }
28:         : {
29:             tool_name: "Edit",
30:             tool_input: {
31:               file_path: a.filePath,
32:               old_string: a.oldString,
33:               new_string: a.newString,
34:               replace_all: !!a.replaceAll,
35:             },
36:           }
37: 
38:       const proc = Bun.spawn([YUL_BIN], { stdin: "pipe", stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" })
39:       proc.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(payload))
40:       proc.stdin.end()
41:       const [code, stderr] = await Promise.all([proc.exited, new Response(proc.stderr).text()])
42:       if (code === 2) throw new Error(stderr.trim() || "yul: blocked outdated dependency")
43:     },
44:   }
45: }
